// @env node
import { argument, defineCommand, exit } from '@argvia/core'
import { runMain } from '@argvia/node'

const app = defineCommand({
  name: 'fixture',
  args: [argument.string('action', { required: true })],
  run({ args }) {
    if (args.action === 'throw')
      throw new Error('业务失败')
    if (args.action === 'reject')
      return Promise.reject(new Error('异步业务失败'))
    if (args.action === 'exit')
      return exit(7)
    if (args.action === 'exit-zero')
      return exit(0)
    if (args.action === 'exit-two')
      return exit(2)
    if (args.action === 'cancel')
      return Promise.resolve(exit(130))
    if (args.action === 'terminate')
      return exit(143)
    if (args.action === 'exit-max')
      return exit(255)
    if (args.action === 'ordinary')
      return { kind: 'exit', exitCode: 7 }
    if (args.action === 'copied')
      return { ...exit(7) }
    if (args.action === 'invalid-exit')
      return exit(-1)
    return 42
  },
})

await runMain(app)
